title: brain-launch: Windows portability (tests hard-code POSIX separators; venv layout)
description: Fresh clone on win32 fails 4 specs in tests/brain-launch.spec.js: the specs hard-code POSIX paths (/w/.venv/bin/wisearcher-mcp) while bin/brain-launch.js builds candidates with path.join, which yields backslashes on Windows, so the injected exists() never matches. Additionally .venv/bin does not exist on Windows venvs (.venv/Scripts, with .exe suffixes). This breaks npm test on any Windows machine and therefore blocks every per-ticket and release gate. Fix the specs to be platform-agnostic (build expectations with the same join/resolve semantics as the code) and make buildLaunchPlan resolve the Windows venv layout, POSIX behavior unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: tests/brain-launch.spec.js passes on win32 AND POSIX: path expectations are built with the same join()/resolve() semantics as the implementation, never hard-coded separators.
buildLaunchPlan also resolves the Windows venv layout (.venv/Scripts/wisearcher-mcp.exe, .venv/Scripts/python.exe) when present; POSIX .venv/bin behavior unchanged.
npm test is green on a fresh Windows clone (fast tier, no red baseline).
If bin/brain-launch.js changes, dist/brain-launch.cjs is rebuilt and dist-parity stays green.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Closed on green review (auto_close_on_green_review grant, session 2026-07-01). Commit 5ee473e: buildLaunchPlan probes both venv layouts (.venv/bin POSIX-first, then .venv/Scripts with .exe) via injected exists(); specs rebuilt with join()/resolve() semantics matching the impl (no hard-coded separators); one new non-vacuous spec for the Scripts layout; dist/brain-launch.cjs rebuilt. Reviewer verdict PASS, 0 HIGH / 0 MEDIUM / 1 LOW on the affected win32 machine: npm test 620 passed/2 skipped (green baseline restored), --changed HEAD~1 green, dist-parity 2/2. Affected-e2e list (dist-parity only) independently confirmed sufficient. LOW follow-up minted separately: python3 fallback interpreter is not on PATH on typical Windows installs.
